page_title: cognee - Memory for Agents, Teams, and People

summary.name: cognee
summary.one_liner: Cognee is an open-source memory engine that gives AI agents and teams durable, searchable memory by connecting sources like Slack, GitHub, and Linear.
use_cases: Keep project context across coding agent sessions
Let agents search company Slack, GitHub, and Linear data
Stop agents repeating tasks they already solved
Generate domain rule ontologies for enterprise agents
Deploy customer-facing agents with cited retrieval
summary.what_it_does: Cognee is a memory layer for AI agents and teams. It can be installed as an open-source Python package (pip install cognee) and connected to Claude Code, Cursor, or any MCP client so agents keep project context across sessions. For teams, it claims to connect sources such as GitHub, Slack, Linear, warehouses, docs, and APIs into one recallable memory that agents can search. It also offers a search call that returns cited answers and generates ontologies that agents can follow for domain rules. The page describes a rollout path from local install, to connecting data sources, to a BYOC production deployment in the customer's own cloud.
notable: Open-source Python package installable with pip
MCP server so compatible agents can read and write memory
Connectors for GitHub, Slack, Linear, warehouses, docs and APIs
Generates ontologies that agents follow for domain rules
caveats: Managed Cognee Cloud is offered for scale, and pricing for it is not stated on the page
Enterprise BYOC deployment is described as a service engagement, with no pricing given
